reviews.text: Comprehensive selection. Expert service
Professional and good service ❤️
Nice place
The staff were very cold and unwelcoming, and they offered no options—basically, they were unhelpful; the service was poor

Huge pet shop store. Little animals, hamsters etc. and small birds. But the main thing is a lots of food and activity toys for big and small animals.

Excellent service and helpfull staff
Hard to find in a basement but worth it. ;)
Good and diverse store, but some things are a bit overpriced.
It's nice to go and watch birds, aquariums, and other animals.
Pet birthday parties for adults
Excellent, professional service.

Great game store with a convenient location and something for everyone. You can play board games, card games, and console games, making it a fun place to spend time with friends.

The game selection is impressive, offering a wide range of board games and card games to choose from.

The staff are friendly, welcoming, and professional, creating a great atmosphere for customers.

I’ll definitely be visiting again with my friends!
I got first Aquarium from here, the staffs help me so much, very very nice service, will come again.
Huge choice, best animal store in the area
First time at Hamsterpapa Kassa for nail trimming. It went really well and the staff was nice and knowledgeable. Good selection of rodent supplies too.

In my opinion, the best pet store in the PK region. Wide selection of equipment, pet food and animals. Maybe a little chaotic, but that just adds to the atmosphere. Once we were running after parrots when the main stars of the birthday party organized at the pet store decided to give a flying show.
Friendly staff :)
You can find anything and everything there.
Maybe the only shop in Helsinki where you can see parrots, and some other animals. I really like it. Also a small cafe area for customers.

Itisen Megaeläinta could soon be called a second home. At least you feel at home every time you enter, and as soon as you leave you are already planning and waiting for the next visit. The staff is amazing in every way. Everyone is really nice and you can find expertise in any animal.
There are a lot of different animals and the selection of animal care and feeding is really wide.
It is always a great pleasure to come here

A really nice place where you can find a wide variety of things for different animals. I got my hamster from that place and the customer service was really good and they even helped me find the right food for my hamster, great!
Good service

Affordable pet shop, in Itis.
Competent staff - Product-aware.
Well-cared for animals. Clean cages,
neat aquariums and terrariums, etc.
Cozy Kameljontti café, 'program'.
Easy to do business - 2 floors, you can easily
park your car near the shop, on both sides.
The shop has moved and grown to about 1500 m2.
An alternative for "Birthday parties"!

Quite ok. Large spaces, lots of products. The café is a nice addition. The animals are quite crowded, as is usually the case in pet stores. However, the children will definitely like to see several different animals. Birds, fish and ground squirrels.
I was just horrified by the prices. There were no sellers in sight, so I couldn't get any help choosing a heat lamp and ended up not buying one.
I think I'll order from somewhere else.

Absolutely amazing place. 1500 square meters, something for absolutely all animals. and the staff is absolutely amazing. The knowledge is absolutely first class, and how ready they are to immediately look for products or give answers to even the most difficult questions.. and they are really happy to give gifts of products.
Great little shop
Absolutely amazing place, the store has everything you could possibly need for animals

Amazing place! We've been going here since the fall to get food and other supplies for our rodent and also stopped by for a coffee. The place exudes a wonderful warmth and it feels like a lot of effort has been put into creating the atmosphere. The cafe is also a great addition to enhance the experience where you can watch the fish at the same time. We'll continue to visit here, it's also a big plus for the atmosphere (they're very warm-hearted).
Really friendly and knowledgeable staff! Genuinely cares about customers' needs😊 …
very good
I was so nice trying, children enjoyed animals, we bought feeds for our birds.
Really nice shop and great service!
Worth a visit 👍 …
Really great place. Cozy experience cafe. Get good food for your cat. Get to see and meet the animals.
amazing customer service and lots of fish and other animals. great store and service❤️

I went there to shop all the supplies and food for my puppy for the first time and I was so happy that the staff helped me with this mission. She was very friendly and acknowledgment. I got all what my puppy needs. Plus it’s kid friendly shop and cafe. My son loves it here, there are so many pets to see.
Animals in small cages :/❤️‍🩹 I personally don't want to buy anything from this store anymore, I don't want to support this. …

A large and versatile pet store that has everything you need. They have fish, rodents, birds, and much more. The staff are knowledgeable, and there’s even a cozy in house café with a nice atmosphere. The store also hosts various animal themed events and is a great place to visit with kids. Plenty of free parking nearby, and it’s easy to reach by public transport too.
Wide selection. Lots of animals.
The customer experience was extremely poor.

One star goes away when there is no sea water side, even on the dry side. And I had to take another star off because the prices have been raised. It used to be the cheapest place, but not anymore. Is it because of the high rent for the new space or because a competitor is out of the picture?
Great place where you can get everything you need under one roof. Service especially from Anu,❤️❤️🔥🔥 …

I would give it a zero if I could. Just because they organize "pet birthday parties". So a bunch of small children get to handle an animal, which of course stresses the animal out, because there are many handlers and this happens several times during the animal's life. The place also sells animals that live in cramped conditions and does not ensure a species-specific living environment for the animals in any way. I don't understand how in 2025 this kind of activity is allowed in Finland.
I thought this would be a bigger experience. However, all the supplies were quite limited. The store was also messy and confusing.
Good place
Nice place for animals, kids like it, and a great cafe with really affordable prices
Huge selection of everything here, lots of variety of pet food that is hard to find elsewhere. Staff very friendly and helpful. They sell birds here 🦜 and fish 🐠 …
Really good store. I found everything I needed.
Big, good selection for cats, etc. Good service and helpful staff.
Experience Café Kameleontti ice latte 3e, wort

I don't usually write reviews, but I had to. I went to Megaeläimi in Itäkeskus on Monday, July 14th, because I'm getting a new pet and needed toys and treats.

Unfortunately, the customer experience was very poor. There was no customer service whatsoever in the store. The salespeople were dressed in their own clothes, which made it difficult to recognize who was a member of staff. It was only clear at the cash register who worked in the store.

During the entire 45-minute visit, no one came to ask if I needed help — not even a greeting when I came in. I tried to ask the salesperson for help many times, but the salespeople just walked past. It felt like they weren't interested in the customer's presence at all. I left the store almost empty-handed because I didn't get the help I needed.

I've worked in customer service in different stores for over ten years, and at each of my jobs I've been taught how to meet customers and how to build good service. I don't blame individual employees, but those responsible for the orientation - the employees are clearly not trained to deal with customers in a professional or friendly manner.

Based on this experience, I don't want to shop at this store again, and unfortunately I can't recommend the Megaeläin chain to others. The only positive aspect was the wide product selection.

We were at Megaeläin Itis for a birthday party, and everything was really well organized. The service and atmosphere were excellent, and we were really happy with the whole experience. I can warmly recommend the place for a party! 10 points for the staff, they knew how to act at every moment. Thank you and have a good summer❤️
We have received good and friendly service for the care of all our furry family members!
A large pet store with a wide selection
All the necessities for animals at a reasonable price
Huh
Fun cafe at the back of the store 👌 …
It's a good pet shop but not as cheap as some other reviews suggest. At least their aquarium section is more pricey than the market.
A really large and diverse pet store.
Service and selection good.
Everything for the animal lover and if not, we will order it. Great service. Easy access

A really great pet store that also sells different animals like rodents, cockroaches, snakes, birds.

A huge selection of supplies for dogs and cats. It's always a pleasure to visit here.

You can also hold birthday parties in the cafe!
Thank you for the good service 👍 …
A large selection of everything for all animals and really nice service!
Really nice salespeople and a great selection of cat food!

It’s like a daycare every time I go there. People bring their kids there to scream and knock on the animal enclosures, and the employees act like it’s nothing, in fact they completely endorse it by having animal petting classes for elementary grade students. It’s really saddening to see animals mistreated like this. Someone really should come and review this place.
This is a really good cafe, good cake 🍰 portions, teas and sweets, very good value for money, I recommend it to everyone …
Great shop and café. Very child-friendly. Homemade ice cream and delicious buns. Interesting animals to keep kids (and adults) entertained for a long time. Café has super cozy jungle-vibe.

A nice pet shop, excellent small animal care service and to top it all off, the Kameleontti experience café inside the pet shop - it's been a positive surprise! Lots of different animal-related activities every week and delicious food in the café.
The staff is not working well. No service or respect for customers, I do not recommend using this bank

An absolutely amazing birthday party place for an 8-year-old girl and her friends. We got to meet many different animals with a wonderful guide and the sweets, chips and juices from the café were delicious in between.
I recommend to everyone

Lovely atmosphere, cafe and good products.
Definitely recommend. My pet shop. ( I especially recommend the cafe. )
A pet food store I visit whenever I'm in that area. The selection is very extensive and even the pickiest of eaters can find their favorite food. Very friendly service.
Excellent selection and service. Highly recommendable.
The store has become really big. There are a lot of interesting things, such as a café. The arrangement is confusing and partly untidy. However, the place has more pluses than minuses.
It was a bit crowded on the weekend when we visited. However, the service was friendly and the selection was nice. Plus, the lovely reptiles and accessories!
Wide selection. Clear. Happy customer service.

Customer service is so bad, the price is dirt expensive even for all animals and goods. That's what they say, greedy for money. Animals are sold to anyone who can take care of them, but the animals can't be cut down, especially birds. Lack of professionalism. The price of goods exceeds the value of the products.

Lots of supplies for all kinds of pets, from rodents to reptiles and cats to spiders. Competent staff, each specializing in a different species, so you can find knowledge and information on everything possible. Animals in good condition and in the right size and properly furnished homes.
See you at Tambere in the popup again 🙏
Really good customer service and nice team, especially Lauri, he is really great and helps a lot and it's a cheap place, thank you very much, you are great.

Great place and service
Except for that one 24/7/365 pride parade creature. Rude and arrogant explained something that the water in the aquariums is very hard (ph) and if your aquariums are not treated with that white powder (they didn't tell you the name of the chemical or what it does) that all the fish will die.
They also explained that you can't choose the fish or you will get what you pay for.
They don't know for sure what happens to the water if the ph is very high.
All the other salespeople are professional and know their job except for that one who doesn't care about the service industry.

If it wasn't for that rude and arrogant salesperson, I would be 5 out of 5
Extensive selection and cute experience cafe
Excellent service
A big pet store and they have everything here
The cafe is perfect, the coffee is good and there is more to offer! Friendly service throughout the house and the animals are doing well in clean conditions. The best pet store😊 …
Great store, with a very wide range of products, and animals are well taken care of!
There were new, large spaces, it was a little difficult to find what I needed and the new location. With the help of the seller, all purchases were successful in the end.
Really a place worth visiting.😍👍 …

I could have given it 0/5 because the customer service was that bad! The seller was rude and nasty, the children asked after the visit why the seller was angry. They clearly spoke badly about us behind the cash register when we left the store, drank juices in the café and admired the animals, too bad if this caused any problems for the seller? Although it doesn't matter, because customer service should always be professional, I will still mention that we behaved professionally and according to the rules. (The children didn't touch the cages, etc.) If I had been without children, I would have asked if there was sand behind the cash register or maybe somewhere else. (There definitely is) Was it because we are of foreign origin? I will never step foot in this store again and I will definitely share my experience with everyone I meet. The animals were cute, I hope they don't collect bad energy from the seller, animals sense everything, especially people with attitude problems like this.
New, good, big spaces. Can fit strollers well too. Lots of everything 😊 …

The animals are happy and plump, the fish are lively and the birds are singing! The service was friendly and nice. I went to buy a new rock for the terrarium + a heat lamp for my pet (the previous one burned out for 8+ years). The experience cafe Kameleont has a lot of different animals and animal exhibitions! The food is good and the cakes were not dry. 10/10 I recommend it to pet lovers!
I've never had to leave empty-handed, I've always found what I needed. And the employees are absolutely wonderful.
Bargain

We went with our 3 and 4 year old sons many times just to look at the fish and we were always able to look in peace even though we didn't buy anything. The intention is to start an aquarium hobby and when we asked the sellers for advice, the answer came when we went to the pharmacy from the shelf... I highly recommend it
